events.speaker: 旁白
events.cn: 很久以前，一位少女的歌声，被封进了水晶球里。
events.en: Long ago, a girl's singing voice was sealed inside a crystal ball.

events.speaker: 旁白
events.cn: 只有唱完一整首歌，她才能重新回到这个世界。
events.en: Only by singing one whole song could she return to this world.

events.speaker: 少女
events.cn: 你不必把沉默解释清楚
events.en: You don't have to explain your silence

events.speaker: 少女
events.cn: 也不必证明伤口曾经痛
events.en: nor prove the wound once hurt.

events.speaker: 少女
events.en: Lay your hand right here and listen —

events.speaker: 少女
events.en: two hearts can sing the selfsame wind.

events.speaker: 少女
events.en: tap — that's the note you let fall.

events.speaker: 少女
events.en: It's all right to miss a beat;

events.speaker: 少女
events.en: I'll wait for you to count again: one, two, three.

events.speaker: 少女
events.en: Lend me just a little melody,

events.speaker: 少女
events.en: even if it's only a single breath.

events.speaker: 少女
events.cn: 我回来了……谢谢你，一直在听。
events.en: I'm back... Thank you for listening all along.
